repairAssignments.decisiveDefect: Two independent defects. First, three of the eight self-help stop conditions the committed track registry establishes for tx_nd_dwi_probation are absent from the delivered packet and from participant-instructions.md, including the § 411.0735 violent-or-sexual court determination, which appears nowhere in the family at all. failedProofObligations.finding: The registry entry carries eight conditions, identically in selfHelpStopConditions and selfHelpBoundaries. The packet's stop list is not derived from them: it is seven bullets hard-coded at scripts/build-census-v1-tx_nd_dwi_probation-set.mjs lines 721-728, reproduced verbatim into participant-instructions.md. Comparing condition by condition and grepping distinguishing terms against BOTH fixtures and the instructions file, three are absent. (1) 'The prosecutor opposes the petition or requests a hearing' — 'opposes' returns 0 everywhere; the packet treats a State hearing request as procedural information, not as a stop. (2) 'Any dispute about whether the sentence, fines, costs or restitution were completed' — 'dispute' returns 0; the packet's only nearby statement runs the other way, reassuring that waiver of fines and costs does not disqualify. (3) 'Any question whether the offence was violent or sexual in nature, which is a court determination under Gov't Code 411.0735' — '411.0735' returns 0 in both fixtures and the md, 'violent' returns 0, 'sexual in nature' returns 0; the two 'sexual' hits in the artifact are offence titles inside the OCA form's own § 411.074 exclusion list, which answers a different question. Two further conditions are present only in narrowed form: the registry stops on a family violence FINDING OR ALLEGATION and the packet stops only on an affirmative finding; the registry stops on any accident ALLEGATION in the offence report and the packet stops only where the offence RESULTED IN a collision. A stop condition exists to catch the participant before the question is resolved against them, so narrowing from allegation to established fact is the wrong direction.
